Ntv Asset Management Has Upped Its Stake in Amgen (AMGN) as Shares Declined; Red Hat (RHT) Shareholder Shannon River Fund Management Cut Position as Stock Price Rose 
March 21, 2018 - By Gary Bell 
Ntv Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Amgen Inc (AMGN) by 16.92% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ntv Asset Management Llc bought 1,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.68% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 13,128 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.45M, up from 11,228 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ntv Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Amgen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $132.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.70% or $1.265   $183.295. About 1.25M shares traded. Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) has risen 5.27%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.43% the S&P500. 
Spencer M. Waxman decreased its stake in Red Hat Inc (RHT) by 3.02% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shannon River Fund Management Llc sold 3,575 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.33% with the market. The hedge fund run by Spencer M. Waxman held 114,825 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $12.73M, down from 118,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shannon River Fund Management Llc who had been investing in Red Hat Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $27.54B market cap company. The stock increased 0.21% or $0.33   $155.61. About 761,470 shares traded. Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) has risen 18.97%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.27% the S&P500. 
Among 35 analysts covering Red Hat ( NYSE:RHT ), 25 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 9 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. Red Hat had 114 analyst reports since August 25, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Hold” on Monday, July 24. The stock of Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) has “Market Perform” rating given on Thursday, October 22 by Cowen & Co. Robert W. Baird maintained Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) rating on Wednesday, June 21. Robert W. Baird has “Neutral” rating and $100 target. UBS maintained Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) on Thursday, September 22 with “Buy” rating. The rating was downgraded by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, December 22 to “Market Perform”. The rating was initiated by Rosenblatt with “Buy” on Monday, November 28. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, June 7 by Jefferies. William Blair maintained the shares of RHT in report on Thursday, March 23 with “Outperform” rating. Northland Capital maintained it with “Buy” rating and $150.0 target in Wednesday, December 20 report. Wells Fargo initiated Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) on Wednesday, January 11 with “Outperform” rating. 
Shannon River Fund Management Llc, which manages about $2.55 billion and $305.64M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Iac Interactivecorp (NASDAQ:IACI) by 11,278 shares to 166,446 shares, valued at $19.57 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in 8X8 Inc New (NASDAQ:EGHT) by 367,459 shares in the quarter, for a total of 583,657 shares, and has risen its stake in Xperi Corp. 
Analysts await Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT) to report earnings on March, 26 after the close. They expect $0.59 EPS, up 40.48% or $0.17 from last year’s $0.42 per share. RHT’s profit will be $104.43M for 65.94 P/E if the $0.59 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual EPS reported by Red Hat, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 9.26% EPS growth. 
Investors sentiment decreased to 1.23 in Q3 2017. Its down 0.02, from 1.25 in 2017Q2. It dived, as 43 investors sold RHT shares while 154 reduced holdings. 65 funds opened positions while 177 raised stakes. 157.62 million shares or 0.16% less from 157.87 million shares in 2017Q2 were reported. (NYSE:RHT). 2,466 were accumulated by Lazard Asset Mgmt Ltd Liability Co. Pine River Capital Mgmt Ltd Partnership accumulated 0.04% or 2,337 shares. Meeder Asset Mngmt invested 0.08% of its portfolio in Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT). Creative Planning has invested 0% of its portfolio in Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT). Balyasny Asset Management Ltd Liability Co reported 1,908 shares. Us Natl Bank De reported 106,106 shares. Brinker Cap accumulated 0.17% or 37,019 shares. 1.87 million were reported by Wells Fargo Mn. Parametric Assocs Lc reported 0.04% stake. Ipg Advsrs Limited invested in 0.08% or 2,225 shares. Los Angeles Cap Mgmt And Equity Rech invested 0% in Red Hat, Inc. (NYSE:RHT). Oppenheimer reported 33,620 shares. Cap Fund Mngmt Sa reported 64,333 shares or 0.05% of all its holdings.

Ntv Asset Management Llc, which manages about $344.82M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,582 shares to 37,301 shares, valued at $5.75M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 4,200 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 33,382 shares, and cut its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Ltd (NYSE:BABA).
